scoring_justification: Recomputing the transition temperatures and exponents from raw simulation data is infeasible in the lightweight verifier sandbox; the agent's final reported values are compared to the paper's published results with tolerances.

required.first_order_transitions: array of objects with numeric field J_over_Jprime and numeric field Tc
required.DLRO_transitions: array of objects with fields J_over_Jprime (number or string 'inf'), Tc (number), nu (number), gamma (number)
required.QLRO_transitions: array of objects with fields J_over_Jprime (number), Tc (number), nu (number), gamma (number)

schema.notes: Numeric values are expected with at least three decimal places. The J_over_Jprime field in DLRO_transitions must be the string 'inf' when representing the bilinear-only limit.

outputs.description: Final extrapolated infinite‑size transition temperatures and critical exponents. The verifier compares the contents against reference values from the reported Monte Carlo study.

output_contract.notes: The output file must contain all three arrays; missing or malformed entries receive zero credit for that part. The verifier uses hidden reference values and will apply appropriate tolerances to each numeric field.

hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Tables I, II and Fig.6
hidden_assets.generation_method: Values extracted directly from the paper. Tolerances: Tc tolerance = 3 * last-digit uncertainty from paper; ν tolerance = 0.05; γ tolerance = 0.10.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the published numbers the reproduction targets; they are the authoritative reference.
